verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has its own built-in LLM chat window. Linked sessions can give context-aware help and explain terminal output with annotations, which can be applied to a failed command's output. It requires installing an optional AI plugin and supplying your own API key, and the user must open the chat and ask. Missing for 10: documented automatic detection of failed commands, explicit suggested-fix output for errors, and hands-on corroboration of explaining failures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI explanations and suggested fixes when a command fails

citations.quote: Link sessions to get context-aware help, run commands on your behalf, or explain output with annotations.
This is an optional component you can install to enable generative AI features in iTerm2.
